module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  predict_valid,
    input  [6:0] predict_pc,
    output reg predict_taken,
    output reg [6:0] predict_history,
    input  train_valid,
    input  train_taken,
    input  train_mispredicted,
    input  [6:0] train_history,
    input  [6:0] train_pc
);
    reg [1:0] pht [0:127];
    reg [6:0] global_history;
    wire [6:0] index = global_history ^ predict_pc;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) begin
            for (int i = 0; i < 128; i = i + 1) pht[i] <= 2'b10;
            global_history <= 7'd0;
        end else begin
            if (predict_valid) begin
                predict_taken <= pht[index][1] > pht[index][0];
                predict_history <= global_history;
            end
            if (train_valid) begin
                pht[index] <= (train_taken && !train_mispredicted) ?
                    {pht[index][1], pht[index][0] + 1'b1} :
                    (train_taken && train_mispredicted) ?
                        {pht[index][1] + 1'b1, pht[index][0]} :
                        {pht[index][1] - 1'b1, pht[index][0]};
                global_history <= (train_mispredicted) ? train_history :
                    (global_history << 1) | train_taken;
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
